title: DyMT-ESB: Dynamic Multi-Turn Evaluation of Social Bias in User-LLM Interactions

bias_targets.methodology: Dynamic multi-turn evaluation (DyMT-ESB) using an LLM to generate user queries from age-related seed stereotypes, followed by an LLM-as-a-Judge to detect explicit or implicit endorsement of the bias in the model's responses.
